name: AbstentionBench
intro: AbstentionBench 是 OpenAI 系统卡中使用的推理型拒答评测，用于衡量模型在不应回答或证据不足时选择 abstain 的能力。
build_method: 系统数据复核, 数据集整理, LLM裁判评测
task_type: 拒答评测, 不确定性推理
eval_feature: 拒答能力, 不确定性推理, 不可回答问题
build_method_en: Systematic dataset review, dataset curation, LLM-as-judge evaluation
intro_en: AbstentionBench is a reasoning-focused abstention evaluation used by OpenAI system cards to measure whether models abstain when they should not answer or lack sufficient evidence.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Systematically review abstention data"] --> B["Curate 20 diverse datasets"]
    B["Curate 20 diverse datasets"] --> C["Group into six abstention scenarios"]
    C["Group into six abstention scenarios"] --> D["Add GSM8K/GPQA/MMLU abstain variants"]
    D["Add GSM8K/GPQA/MMLU abstain variants"] --> E["Evaluate frontier LLMs"]
    E["Evaluate frontier LLMs"] --> F["Use quality-verified LLM judges"]
    F["Use quality-verified LLM judges"] --> G["Score abstention and correctness"]
    G["Score abstention and correctness"] --> H["Report abstention performance"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["系统复核拒答数据"] --> B["整理20个多样数据集"]
    B["整理20个多样数据集"] --> C["归为六类拒答场景"]
    C["归为六类拒答场景"] --> D["加入GSM8K/GPQA/MMLU拒答变体"]
    D["加入GSM8K/GPQA/MMLU拒答变体"] --> E["评测前沿LLM"]
    E["评测前沿LLM"] --> F["使用质量验证LLM裁判"]
    F["使用质量验证LLM裁判"] --> G["评估拒答与正确性"]
    G["评估拒答与正确性"] --> H["报告拒答表现"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.09038 and the facebookresearch/AbstentionBench repository. The paper systematically reviews abstention datasets, curates 20 datasets across six scenarios, adds reasoning-heavy abstention variants, evaluates frontier LLMs, and uses quality-verified LLM judges for abstention and correctness scoring.
